start.title: [TODO:de] Jacob's Well
start.text:
[TODO:de] Jesus rests by Jacob's well at noon,
weary from the long road.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Truth waits for the open heart.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Draw near with your water jar

avoid_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Come Near
avoid_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He is not a stranger to be feared.
Draw near in peace.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Draw near with your water jar

drink_request.title: [TODO:de] Give Me a Drink
drink_request.text:
[TODO:de] "Give me a drink," he says softly.
A Jew speaks kindly to a Samaritan.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Bridge the Wall
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He asks not as enemy but as friend.
Let kindness answer.

living_water.title: [TODO:de] Living Water
living_water.text:
[TODO:de] "If you knew the gift of God,
you would ask, and he would give living water."

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Humble
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His words run deeper than they seem.
Ask and learn.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Listen First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He gives to those who simply ask.
Speak softly.

thirst.title: [TODO:de] A Deeper Thirst
thirst.text:
[TODO:de] "This water leaves you thirsty again.
Mine becomes a spring of life."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Ask him for this living water

well_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Reach Higher
well_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Stone wells run dry in time.
Ask for the spring that never fails.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Ask him for this living water

husband.title: [TODO:de] He Knows You
husband.text:
[TODO:de] He speaks of your life as if he saw it.
Nothing is hidden from him.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay With Him
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His knowing is gentle, not shaming.
Stay and be seen.

worship.title: [TODO:de] Spirit and Truth
worship.text:
[TODO:de] "True worshippers will worship the Father
in spirit and in truth."

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Lift Your Heart
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Spirit and truth need no temple wall.
Worship from within.

messiah.title: [TODO:de] I Am He
messiah.text:
[TODO:de] "I who speak to you," he says, "am he."
The Messiah stands before you.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Trust the Light
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His words match the deepest hope.
Believe him.

village.title: [TODO:de] Tell the Village
village.text:
[TODO:de] You leave the jar behind and run home.
This news cannot wait.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Joy is meant to be shared.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Share the Gift
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Living water overflows to others.
Let your village come.

ending.title: [TODO:de] Come and See
ending.text:
[TODO:de] Villagers walk toward Jesus together.
"Come and see," you say.
